source_text: [1] Ἐγὼ γράφω πάσαις ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις, καὶ ἐντέλλομαι πᾶσιν, ὅτι ἐγὼ ἑκὼν ὑπὲρ θεοῦ ἀποθνήσκω, ἐάνπερ ὑμεῖς μὴ κωλύσητε. παρακαλῶ ὑμᾶς, μὴ εὔνοια ἄκαιρος γένησθέ μοι. ἄφετέ με θηρίων εἶναι βοράν, δἰ ὦν ἔνεστιν θεοῦ ἐπιτυχεῖν. σῖτός εἰμι θεοῦ καὶ δἰ ὀδόντων θηρίων ἀλήθομαι, ἵνα καθαρὸς ἄρτος εὑρεθῶ τοῦ Χριστοῦ. [2] μᾶλλον κολακεύσατε τὰ θηρία, ἵνα μοι τάφος γένωνται καὶ μηθὲν καταλίπωσι τῶν τοῦ σώματός μου, ἵνα μὴ κοιμηθεὶς βαρύς τινι γένωμαι. τότε ἔσομαι μαθητὴς ἀληθῶς Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὅτε οὐδὲ τὸ σῶμά μου ὁ κόσμος ὄψεται. λιτανεύσατε τὸν Χριστὸν ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ, ἵνα διὰ τῶν ὀργάνων τούτων θυσία εὑρεθῶ. [3] οὐχ ὡς Πέτρος καὶ Παῦλος διατάσσομαι ὑμῖν. ἐκεῖνοι ἀπόστολοι, ἐγὼ κατάκριτος: ἐκεῖνοι ἐλεύθεροι, ἐγὼ δὲ μέχρι νῦν δοῦλος. ἀλλ’ ἐὰν πάθω, ἀπελεύθερος γενήσομαι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἀναστήσομαι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐλεύθερος. νῦν μανθάνω δεδεμένος μηδὲν ἐπιθυμεῖν.
thought_title: God's wheat, ground by the beasts
pass_a_gloss: I write to all the churches and I give instruction to all that I die willingly on behalf of God, if indeed you do not hinder it. I urge you, do not become an untimely goodwill to me. Allow me to be food of beasts, through whom it is possible to attain to God. I am wheat of God, and I am being ground through the teeth of beasts, so that I may be found pure bread of Christ. Rather, coax the beasts, so that they may become a tomb for me and may leave nothing of the things of my body, so that having fallen asleep I may not become heavy to anyone. Then I will truly be a disciple of Jesus Christ, when the world will not even see my body. Entreat Christ on my behalf, that through these instruments I may be found a sacrifice. I do not command you as Peter and Paul did. They were apostles, I am a condemned man; they were free, but I until now am a slave. But if I suffer, I will become a freedman of Jesus Christ and I will rise in him free. Now, being bound, I am learning to desire nothing.
pass_b_english: I am writing to all the churches, and I tell everyone that I die for God willingly, if indeed you do not hinder me. I beg you, do not be a kindness at the wrong time to me. Let me be food for the beasts; through them I can reach God. I am God's wheat, and I am being ground by the teeth of beasts so that I may be found pure bread of Christ.

Better still, coax the beasts, so that they become my tomb and leave nothing of my body behind, so that when I have fallen asleep I may not be a burden to anyone. Then I will truly be a disciple of Jesus Christ, when the world will not see even my body. Plead with Christ for me, that through these instruments I may be found a sacrifice.

I do not give you orders as Peter and Paul did. They were apostles; I am a condemned man. They were free; I am still a slave, even now. But if I suffer, I will become Jesus Christ's freedman, and I will rise in him free. Now, in chains, I am learning to want nothing.

review.notes: Checked paragraph [1] in full against Pass A and Pass B. Pass A keeps ἑκών, both ἵνα clauses, and οὐδέ: 'I die willingly on behalf of God, if indeed you do not hinder it'; 'so that having fallen asleep I may not become heavy to anyone'; 'when the world will not even see my body'. Pass B contradicts those clauses with 'I die for God gladly, unless you stand in my way', 'and when I fall asleep I am a burden to no one', and 'when the world no longer sees even my body'. Title names the wheat image. No inline citation is attached to a quoted clause; the 1 Cor 7:22 echo is only noted as possible.
reasons: Pass B changes what is denied and the future: Greek 'ὅτε οὐδὲ τὸ σῶμά μου ὁ κόσμος ὄψεται' and Pass A 'when the world will not even see my body' versus Pass B 'when the world no longer sees even my body'.

Pass B drops purpose and the subjunctive of becoming: Greek 'ἵνα μὴ κοιμηθεὶς βαρύς τινι γένωμαι' and Pass A 'so that having fallen asleep I may not become heavy to anyone' versus Pass B 'and when I fall asleep I am a burden to no one'.

Pass B replaces voluntary death and the emphatic condition: Greek 'ἐγὼ ἑκὼν ὑπὲρ θεοῦ ἀποθνήσκω, ἐάνπερ ὑμεῖς μὴ κωλύσητε' and Pass A 'I die willingly on behalf of God, if indeed you do not hinder it' versus Pass B 'I die for God gladly, unless you stand in my way'.
